decisions.reason: The SI README gives a paper-specific Zenodo record hosting the actual MedMNIST-based files used for training/testing, which is a real data identifier differing from the generic medmnist.com in the extraction; it refers to this paper's own dataset, not a control.
decisions.evidence_quote: The MedMNIST datasets based files used for training and testing QML models are available at <https://zenodo.org/records/15058309>
